permission-denied.title: Permission denied
permission-denied.explanation: The current user is not allowed to do this. The file or directory belongs to another user (often root).

no-such-file.title: No such file or directory
no-such-file.explanation: The path is wrong or the object does not exist. Check the spelling and your current directory.

command-not-found.title: Command not found
command-not-found.explanation: No such program in PATH. It may not be installed, or the name has a typo.

disk-full.title: No space left on device
disk-full.explanation: The partition is out of free space. Free some space or grow the disk.

out-of-memory.title: Out of memory
out-of-memory.explanation: The system ran out of RAM for the operation. The process may have been killed by the OOM killer.

segfault.title: Segmentation fault
segfault.explanation: The program accessed invalid memory and crashed. This is often a bug in the program itself.

syntax-error.title: Syntax error
syntax-error.explanation: The shell or interpreter could not parse the command. Check quotes, brackets and special characters.

ssh-connection-refused.title: Connection refused
ssh-connection-refused.explanation: The server is reachable, but nothing listens on that port. The SSH service may be down or the port differs.

ssh-permission-denied-publickey.title: Key was rejected
ssh-permission-denied-publickey.explanation: The server rejected key authentication. The public key is not on the server, the wrong key is used, or key file permissions are wrong.

ssh-host-key-verification-failed.title: Host key verification failed
ssh-host-key-verification-failed.explanation: The server fingerprint does not match the one saved in known_hosts. The server may have been reinstalled — or this is an interception attempt. Do not connect until you are sure it is your server.

ssh-connection-timed-out.title: Connection timed out
ssh-connection-timed-out.explanation: The server did not respond in time. It may be off, unreachable, or blocked by a firewall.
